require 'fluent/match'
require 'fluent/event'
require 'fluent/filter'
require 'fluent/msgpack_factory'

module Fluent
  #
  # EventRouter is responsible to route events to a collector.
  #
  # It has a list of MatchPattern and Collector pairs:
  #
  #  +----------------+     +-----------------+
  #  |  MatchPattern  |     |    Collector    |
  #  +----------------+     +-----------------+
  #  |   access.**  ---------> type forward   |
  #  |     logs.**  ---------> type copy      |
  #  |  archive.**  ---------> type s3        |
  #  +----------------+     +-----------------+
  #
  # EventRouter does:
  #
  # 1) receive an event at `#emit` methods
  # 2) match the event's tag with the MatchPatterns
  # 3) forward the event to the corresponding Collector
  #
  # Collector is either of Output, Filter or other EventRouter.
  #
  class EventRouter
    def initialize(default_collector, emit_error_handler)
      @match_rules = []
      @match_cache = MatchCache.new
      @default_collector = default_collector
      @emit_error_handler = emit_error_handler
      @metric_callbacks = {}
      @caller_plugin_id = nil
    end

    attr_accessor :default_collector
    attr_accessor :emit_error_handler

    class Rule
      def initialize(pattern, collector)
        patterns = pattern.split(/\s+/).map { |str| MatchPattern.create(str) }
        @pattern = if patterns.length == 1
                     patterns[0]
                   else
                     OrMatchPattern.new(patterns)
                   end
        @pattern_str = pattern
        @collector = collector
      end

      def match?(tag)
        @pattern.match(tag)
      end

      attr_reader :collector
      attr_reader :pattern_str
    end

    def suppress_missing_match!
      if @default_collector.respond_to?(:suppress_missing_match!)
        @default_collector.suppress_missing_match!
      end
    end

    # called by Agent to add new match pattern and collector
    def add_rule(pattern, collector)
      @match_rules << Rule.new(pattern, collector)
    end

    def add_metric_callbacks(caller_plugin_id, callback)
      @metric_callbacks[caller_plugin_id] = callback
    end

    def caller_plugin_id=(caller_plugin_id)
      @caller_plugin_id = caller_plugin_id
    end

    def find_callback
      if @caller_plugin_id
        @metric_callbacks[@caller_plugin_id]
      else
        nil
      end
    end

    def emit(tag, time, record)
      unless record.nil?
        emit_stream(tag, OneEventStream.new(time, record))
      end
    end

    def emit_array(tag, array)
      emit_stream(tag, ArrayEventStream.new(array))
    end

    def emit_stream(tag, es)
      processed = es
      begin
        cache_map = @match_cache.instance_variable_get(:@map)
        cache_keys = @match_cache.instance_variable_get(:@keys)
        collector = cache_map[tag]
        unless collector
          pipeline = nil
          found = nil
          @match_rules.each_with_index do |rule, i|
            if rule.match?(tag)
              collector_obj = rule.collector
              if collector_obj.is_a?(Plugin::Filter)
                if pipeline.nil?
                  pipeline = Pipeline.new
                end
                pipeline.add_filter(collector_obj)
              else
                if pipeline
                  pipeline.set_output(collector_obj)
                  found = pipeline
                else
                  found = collector_obj
                end
                break
              end
            end
          end
          if found.nil?
            if pipeline
              pipeline.set_output(@default_collector)
              found = pipeline
            end
          end
          collector = found || @default_collector
          cache_map[tag] = collector
          current_size = cache_keys.size
          cache_limit = MatchCache::MATCH_CACHE_SIZE
          if current_size >= cache_limit
            expired = cache_keys.shift
            cache_map.delete(expired)
          end
          cache_keys << tag
        end

        if collector.is_a?(Pipeline)
          filters = collector.instance_variable_get(:@filters)
          output = collector.instance_variable_get(:@output)
          optimizer = collector.instance_variable_get(:@optimizer)
          optimizable = optimizer.instance_variable_get(:@optimizable)
          if optimizable.nil?
            fs_filters = optimizer.instance_variable_get(:@filters_having_filter_stream)
            if fs_filters.nil?
              fs_filters = []
              filter_index = 0
              while filter_index < filters.length
                filter = filters[filter_index]
                filter_index += 1
                implemented = filter.class.instance_methods(false)
                if implemented.include?(:filter_stream)
                  fs_filters << filter
                end
              end
              optimizer.instance_variable_set(:@filters_having_filter_stream, fs_filters)
            end
            if fs_filters.empty?
              optimizable = true
            else
              if filters.size > 1 && fs_filters.size >= 1
                $log.info "disable filter chain optimization because #{fs_filters.map(&:class)} uses `#filter_stream` method."
              end
              optimizable = false
            end
            optimizer.instance_variable_set(:@optimizable, optimizable)
          end

            new_es = MultiEventStream.new
            if es.is_a?(MessagePackEventStream)
              packed_times = es.instance_variable_get(:@unpacked_times)
              packed_records = es.instance_variable_get(:@unpacked_records)
              if packed_times && packed_records
                materialized = MultiEventStream.new(packed_times.dup, packed_records.dup)

                if unpacker.nil?

                materialized = MultiEventStream.new

              record = es.instance_variable_get(:@record)

              filtered_record = record
              skip_event = false

                    tagged = tag
                    current_time = filtered_time
                    current_record = filtered_record
                    filtered_time, filtered_record = filter.filter_with_time(tagged, current_time, current_record)

                    skip_event = true unless keep
                    measured_es = OneEventStream.new(time, record)

                    current_record = filtered_record
                    filtered_record = filter.filter(tagged, current_time, current_record)

                    skip_event = true unless keep
                    measured_es = OneEventStream.new(time, record)
                    filter.measure_metrics(measured_es) unless skip_event
                  rescue => e
                    filter.router.emit_error_event(tag, filtered_time, filtered_record, e)
                  end

              new_es.add(filtered_time, filtered_record) unless skip_event
            elsif es.is_a?(ArrayEventStream)
              entries = es.instance_variable_get(:@entries)
              entries.each do |time, record|
                filtered_time = time
                filtered_record = record
                skip_event = false
                filters.each do |filter|
                  break if skip_event
                  if filter.has_filter_with_time
                    begin

                      filter.router.emit_error_event(tag, filtered_time, filtered_record, e)
                    end
                  end
                end
                new_es.add(filtered_time, filtered_record) unless skip_event
              end
            elsif es.is_a?(MultiEventStream)
              time_array = es.instance_variable_get(:@time_array)
              record_array = es.instance_variable_get(:@record_array)
              idx = 0
              length = time_array.length
              while idx < length
                time = time_array[idx]
                record = record_array[idx]
                idx += 1
                filtered_time = time
                filtered_record = record
                skip_event = false
                filters.each do |filter|
                  break if skip_event
                  if filter.has_filter_with_time
                    begin
                      tagged = tag
                      current_time = filtered_time
                      current_record = filtered_record
                      filtered_time, filtered_record = filter.filter_with_time(tagged, current_time, current_record)
                      keep = filtered_record && filtered_time
                      skip_event = true unless keep
                      measured_es = OneEventStream.new(time, record)
                      filter.measure_metrics(measured_es) unless skip_event
                    rescue => e
                      filter.router.emit_error_event(tag, filtered_time, filtered_record, e)
                    end
                  else
                    begin
                      tagged = tag
                      current_time = filtered_time
                      current_record = filtered_record
                      filtered_record = filter.filter(tagged, current_time, current_record)
                      keep = filtered_record
                      skip_event = true unless keep
                      measured_es = OneEventStream.new(time, record)
                      filter.measure_metrics(measured_es) unless skip_event
                    rescue => e
                      filter.router.emit_error_event(tag, filtered_time, filtered_record, e)
                    end
                  end
                end
                new_es.add(filtered_time, filtered_record) unless skip_event
              end
            else
              es.each do |time, record|
                filtered_time = time
                filtered_record = record
                skip_event = false
                filters.each do |filter|
                  break if skip_event
                  if filter.has_filter_with_time
                    begin
                      tagged = tag
                      current_time = filtered_time

                      filtered_time, filtered_record = filter.filter_with_time(tagged, current_time, current_record)

                      filter.measure_metrics(measured_es) unless skip_event
                    rescue => e
                      filter.router.emit_error_event(tag, filtered_time, filtered_record, e)
                    end

                    begin
                      tagged = tag

                      current_record = filtered_record
                      filtered_record = filter.filter(tagged, current_time, current_record)
                      keep = filtered_record

                      measured_es = OneEventStream.new(time, record)
                      filter.measure_metrics(measured_es) unless skip_event

        find(tag) || @default_collector

      collector
